A '''droid''' was in charge of guarding the [[Sienar Test Facility 73|facility]] where the [[TIE Avenger prototype]] was located.

==History==
In [[4 BBY]], the droid guarded the prototype [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]] in its [[hangar]] in [[Sienar Test Facility 73]] on the [[planet]] [[73]]. When a worker named [[Niya]], who was secretly in contact with the [[Axis network]], inspected the prototype, the [[droid]] was present. After Niya completed her check, she slotted her [[datapad]] into the droid. When the rebel [[Spy|operative]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor]], assisted by Niya and disguised as an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Sienar test pilot|test pilot]], entered the hangar with the intention of [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|stealing]] the Avenger, he removed its fuel pipes and made a noise in the process. The droid came to investigate, and Andor shot it with his [[SE-14r light repeating blaster]].<ref name="OYL" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The droid was assembled by prop makers [[Matt McMurray]] and [[Robert Skene]] for [[Neal Scanlan]]'s creature shop, with [[Kenny Wilson]] as Moldshop HOD.<ref name="SkeneInstagram">{{Instagram|username=robskenefx|url=p/DN39vtAiB-_|name=Robert Skene|date=2025-08-28|quote=A little late to the party, but I'm finally getting around to posting some of the stuff I was lucky enough to work on for season 2 of Andor. This was such a fun project to work on, and is an incredible show! For the Sienar droid I molded and cast the 'wings' in fiberglass, and the 'fingers' it walks with were silicone block molds and cast in urethane, with each joint being separate for articulation. The build for this guy was primarily looked after by Matt McMurray. All work done for Neal Scanlon's creature shop, with Kenny Wilson as Moldshop HOD.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/kftzs}}</ref>
